an10.68:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā naḷakapāne viharati palāsavane.
an10.68:1.2: tena kho pana samayena tadahuposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
an10.68:1.3: atha kho bhagavā bahudevarattiṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi.
an10.68:2.5: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato paccassosi.
an10.68:3.1: atha kho bhagavā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā,
an10.68:3.2: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhu āmantesi
an10.68:3.4: ‘āvuso’ti kho te bhikkhu āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
